policy: Four native capability packages remain independently usable. Pi is unmodified and owns model execution and JSONL. Host controllers are original; the ISC pi-background-tasks process backend is retained with documented adaptations and source integrity. DeepSeek roster/mailbox and TeamAction interactions are adapted with retained MIT notices; remaining frameworks are references only.

sources.name: Pi
sources.use: Public SDK, native Agent execution and JSONL sessions, extension/event/compaction APIs; built as a coherent official offline tarball set.

sources.name: Friend
sources.use: User-owned prior product; project/session sidebar, conversation and on-demand workstation layout. No source copied.

sources.name: DeepSeekHarness
sources.use: Persistent roster, receiver-local mailbox ordering/receipts and TeamAction navigation adapted to Pi, SQLite and Friend UI; no upstream loop or Cordis runtime bundled.

additionalAdaptations.use: Continuous tool/reasoning process groups, activity summaries, independent default-collapsed disclosures and bounded group scrolling adapted to the existing Pi timeline; tool result image previews use native Pi parts. No upstream runtime or store included.

sources.name: MiniMax Code
sources.use: Agent runtime and scheduling research; no implementation files incorporated.

sources.name: ZCode
sources.use: Client/runtime separation and cancellation/recovery research; no implementation files incorporated.

sources.name: Codex
sources.use: Cancellation, tool authority and memory/context research; no implementation files incorporated.

sources.name: MiMo-Code
sources.use: Context rebuilding and coverage/watermark research; no implementation files incorporated.

sources.name: pi-gui
sources.use: Public README/license and SDK-first Electron-client comparison; no client source copied.

sources.name: pi-subagents
sources.use: Public README/license, independent sessions and member lifecycle comparison; no framework installed or copied.

sources.name: pi-agent-orchestrator
sources.use: Public README/license, worktree collaboration and progress comparison; no framework installed or copied.

sources.name: Mem0
sources.use: Public README/license and separating retrieval, update and deletion; no library/service required or incorporated.

sources.name: Electron
sources.use: Official macOS arm64 distribution. Packaging changes application identity and adds a local ad-hoc outer signature for ARM64 execution; upstream nested framework signatures and Chromium notices are retained. No Developer ID, --deep signing or notarization.

sources.name: Node.js
sources.use: Unmodified official arm64 Node executable and original full LICENSE, including bundled components.

sources.name: npm CLI
sources.use: Pinned runtime npm/npx and complete npm dependencies, for local project validation. Original notices remain in the runtime tree.

sources.name: React/React DOM
sources.use: Browser renderer includes React/React DOM and scheduler from the lockfile; original licenses are copied to third-party-licenses.
